subintervals.P0_POSTPROCESS_TOTAL: Existing postprocessStart through existing postprocessEnd; retain both markers and surrounding PostprocessBegin/Done state marks.
subintervals.P1_SCORE_TRANSFORM: New timestamp immediately before the existing complete score-generation loop through a timestamp immediately after it; includes int16 conversion, scale, exact expf sigmoid, score store, finite and threshold counts.
subintervals.P2_TOPK_SELECTION: Timestamp after the finite-count guard, immediately before top-array/count setup and existing top-k scan, through a timestamp immediately after that scan.
subintervals.P3_TOP_RESULT_MATERIALIZATION: Reuse P2 end as P3 start; end timestamp immediately after existing topCount and top index/scoreBits materialization loop.
subintervals.P_UNCLASSIFIED_RESIDUAL: P0 - P1 - P2 - P3, including wrapper state marks, entry/exit, finite guard, marker/counter-record costs not already bracketed and all other gaps.

exact_cycle_accounting: For each valid measured run, P1+P2+P3+explicit_residual == P0 exactly in uint64 cycles; ordered nonoverlapping intervals, residual>=0; no rounded-ms reconciliation.

operation_counts.counter_update_rule: Count only actual comparison evaluation and shift execution, preserving short circuit, branch outcomes, tie arithmetic, scan order and writes; no branch depends on counters.

diagnostic_export: A new diagnostic-only H1CP reader may return latest or indexed measured raw observer data after inference; do not alter existing production result serialization or existing profile layouts.
retention: Snapshot the latest observer into separate measured-slot storage only after existing primary end/h1BaselineEndRun. Diagnostic campaign slot association must bind campaign, sample index and run sequence.

physical_campaign.route: Existing RunBaselineDiagnostic(145), canonical uploaded/resident production input

noninterference_gates: Same FP arithmetic instructions/order modulo unavoidable markers/counters
Same loop counts, branches, result writes, exact score bits and ties
Exact full externally observable result and full score vector compared with lifecycle reference
Exact model/Vela, U85 routes, persistent lifecycle/storage, memory ownership and cache operations
Production qualified RAM regions/objects unchanged; observer storage separately bounded
No CPU fallback, faults, guard failures, context drift or persistent model mutation
